title: The Cosmic Game
author: Stanislav Grof
description: Stanislav Grof explores consciousness, spiritual experience and the nature of reality through the perspective of transpersonal psychology. The work considers how experiences beyond the everyday sense of self shape questions of existence, meaning and the cosmos.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
